categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Green Precision Components Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of precision structural components and precision molds. Its products are widely used in smart home devices, smartphones, wearable devices, tablets, and electronic cigarettes. The company also produces precision molds essential for manufacturing precision structural parts.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes injection molding, metal forming, surface treatment, stamping, CNC machining, die-casting, and automated manufacturing technologies. It emphasizes high-precision mold design and manufacturing, integrating multiple materials such as plastics, metals, and glass. The firm also develops automated assembly lines and precision inspection equipment to enhance product quality and production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include well-known domestic and international brands in the smart terminal sector, covering smart home appliances, smartphones, wearable devices, tablets, electronic cigarettes, home robots, drones, and other smart terminals. The company serves primarily the computer, communication, and other electronic equipment manufacturing industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant overseas sales, including subsidiaries and manufacturing bases in Vietnam, Singapore, and Hong Kong. Its sales are split between domestic (42.32%) and international markets (57.68%), with ongoing expansion in emerging markets such as the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Australia-New Zealand, South America, and Russia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong Green Precision Components operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing precision structural components and molds that are critical upstream inputs for smart terminal device assembly and production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in 'functionalization of structural components,' investing in new materials, technologies, and processes to develop high value-added products. It aims to enhance modular intelligent manufacturing and deepen cooperation with universities and research institutions to expand R&D in drones, satellite communications, new energy, and medical aesthetics. Automation and smart manufacturing are key R&D themes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of precision structural components and precision molds. The company operates a direct sales model, with revenue recognized at the point of product delivery and customer acceptance. It also earns investment income from financial products but this is not a core revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a strong market position as a high-tech precision structural component supplier to leading smart terminal brands domestically and internationally. It competes on technological innovation, integrated multi-material design, and rapid delivery capabilities. Specific competitors are not named, but the firm emphasizes its comprehensive technical solutions and stable customer relationships as competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.22 billion, an 8.63% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 53 million, a 308.51% increase. The company maintains steady growth with a total asset base of over RMB 2.22 billion and a net asset value of RMB 1.9 billion. It has a workforce of 3,851 employees and continues to invest significantly in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its ability to integrate multiple materials and functions—such as antennas, electromagnetic shielding, acoustic chambers, heat dissipation, waterproofing, dustproofing, decoration, anti-static, and hypoallergenic features—into precision structural components. It offers customized, non-standard products with rapid iteration and delivery capabilities, supported by advanced manufacturing technologies and comprehensive one-stop technical solutions.
